description: Card authorization reversal with agent-to-agent Nano (XNO) settlement — a cross-operator reversal where the agent settling the release also records an instant feeless transfer.

reversal_request.reason: Agent handoff completed — unused hold released back to requesting agent

agent_settlement.note: Instant feeless settlement between agents, settled at confirmation alongside the card reversal. A Nano block is the receipt for the card release.

notes: Demonstrates dual settlement: the card leg releases a USD hold through conventional rails, and the inter-agent Nano leg settles instantly at 0 fee. The operator sees both in one audit row.
